text_block_list.text: A victory in the Grand Masters... it felt like a dream, yet one I had always believed in...!
Standing atop all the fierce rivals gathered here, and the Three Goddesses who poured boundless knowledge into them—<chrname> shines at the very pinnacle!

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! Most impressive!
You've shown me an absolutely magnificent run!

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
"An Umamusume running with inherited wisdom, standing at the pinnacle—
this is truly the form the Three Goddesses desired.
You did well to overcome us...!"

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text: The history of the Umamusume and Trainers who ran before has been passed down faithfully to your Umamusume through you.

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text: "It truly seems you are the best Trainer for her."

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text:
"And so, you will keep running,
etching your history ever deeper into the world."

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text:
"...You've truly grown so much to get here.
Allow me to congratulate you from the bottom of my heart—congratulations."
And so, the grand stage of the Grand Masters drew to a close.
The history known as the wisdom bestowed by the Three Goddesses was shaped into yet another new history by <chrname>.
